title: My space
notSignedIn: Sign in to see your space: your clubs, series and events, and your own papers.

documents.title: My documents
documents.hint: Licences and certificates you may be asked for. The organizers of the events you work at and of the clubs you belong to can see them; every look is logged.
documents.fileHint: PDF, JPEG or PNG, at most 10 MB

bank.title: Bank account
bank.hint: Where your costs are paid back to. Only you see it here; when you submit a claim, holder and IBAN are copied onto that claim for whoever pays it.

claims.newHint: For an event you worked at, or for a club you belong to. The event's host club, or your club, pays it back.
claims.noTargets: There is nothing you can claim on yet: claims are for the work you do at an event — as a helper, on the jury, on the race committee or as its organizer — and for your club, once you are a member.
claims.receiptsEmpty: None — an item's own receipts are under the item.
claims.withdrawPrompt: A withdrawn claim cannot be submitted again.

unavailable.at: {relation, select, jury {You are on the jury at {event},} race_officer {You are on the race committee at {event},} manager {You organize {event},} helper {You are a helper at {event},} other {You work at {event},}}
unavailable.noHostClub: but it has no host club yet — the host club pays the claims. Ask its organizer to set one.
unavailable.notCovered: but its host club does not pay for this work.

claims.reopenHint: You can still change it until it is approved — a change makes it a draft again, to be submitted again.
claims.untilHint: Only for several days — a hotel's nights, a weekend's per-diem.

pending.title: Reimbursements
pending.hint: Claims on the events and clubs whose money you hold: to decide, or approved and still to pay. Your own claims are never here — somebody else decides those.
pending.noteHint: required to reject — the claimant reads it, corrects the claim and submits it again
pending.payByHandHint: Paid one transfer by hand in your own banking? Record it here. For several claims, a SEPA file under Payment runs is quicker.
pending.girocodeHint: Scan it with your banking app's photo transfer: payee, IBAN, amount and reference are filled in, and your TAN pays. Then press “Mark as paid”.

bankRun.accountHint: The account the club pays from. Only the club's manager and treasurer see it here.
bankRun.bicHint: optional — filled in from the IBAN
bankRun.sepaHint: One file for the club's online banking: upload it there as a collective transfer and confirm it with one TAN. The claims stay "in payment" until you mark the run as booked.
bankRun.noAccount: Save the club's account first — it is the account the transfers leave from.
bankRun.created: The file is created and downloading. Upload it in the club's online banking.
bankRun.runHint: Upload the file in the club's online banking (one TAN). When the transfers show on the statement, press "Booked". A transfer the bank returned is marked one by one. Uploading the same file twice is refused by the bank.
bankRun.booksHint: Every claim the club paid or owes in a year, one row per item — for the cash audit.

eventSections.peopleHint: The event's officials and helpers: its organizers, race committee, jury, helpers and treasurer.
eventSections.raceControlScreen: The race committee's screen on the water: start, recall and finish races, one at a time.
eventSections.resultsText: The race committee enters the results on the event's page, in its tab Enter results.
eventSections.resultsDraft: The event is still a draft. Results are entered on its page once it is published.
eventSections.notReadyTitle: Not ready for the draw and the start yet
eventSections.configurationFrozen: Racing has begun: the series, the act, the size, the teams per club and the boats stay as they are. Title, host, venue and dates can still be changed.
eventSections.resizeDiscardsDraw: Saving a new size discards the pairing list drawn for the old one — draw again afterwards.

clubSections.hostingHint: The events your club hosts. Each one is organized in its own place — the date, the clubs, the draw and publication. An event outside a series you create here too.
clubSections.noHosted: Your club hosts no event yet.
clubSections.noRuns: No approved claims to pay and no payment run at the bank.
clubSections.name: Name
clubSections.factsByOffice: Name, short name, city and website are changed by the league office — write to it if one is wrong.
clubSections.applicationsHint: An application counts once the series' organizer accepts it; until then the club is not listed in the series.
clubSections.applyNone: No published series this year or next that the club is not already in.

seriesSections.notFound: This series is not among the ones you organize.
seriesSections.clubsHint: The clubs taking part in this series. Set here, a club is registered at once; a club that has already raced cannot be removed.
seriesSections.publicationHint: Publishing changes only who can see the series; everything stays editable, and each event keeps its own publication.
seriesSections.officialsHint: Who holds what on the series. A race officer or jury member named here is one at every event of it.
seriesSections.standingsHint: The table is on the series' public page, recomputed from the results.
seriesSections.standingsDraft: The series is a draft — its standings appear on the public page once it is published.
